mcb.standard: IS/IEC 60898-1 (household/similar). For industrial MCBs makers also cite IEC 60947-2.

rated_current_series_A.source: B7 (range 0.5-63 A only), B14 (fuse steps 2/6/10/16/25/32 A)
rated_current_series_A.note: Range 0.5-63 A verified (Havells). Individual steps listed are the common catalogue steps; IEC 60898-1 preferred-value list itself not seen.

table.use: Circuits whose equipment does not cause surge current: lighting and socket-outlet circuits (B1).
Circuits with equipment that causes surge current: inductive and motor circuits (B1). Default for mixed domestic/commercial power circuits.
High inrush when switched on, typically ~15x running current: transformers, heavy-start motors, 2-pole motors (B1). Havells: inrush typically 12-15x (B7).

breaking_capacity.rule: Icn of the MCB (or Icu of the upstream device when cascading) must be >= prospective short-circuit current at its point of installation.
breaking_capacity.rule_source: B4 (SP 30 cascading clause: 'The upstream device must have an ultimate breaking capacity greater than or equal to the assumed short-circuit current at the installation point'); B1 G.2.5 for RCCB back-up
breaking_capacity.common_ratings_note: 10 kA verified as a catalogue value (B7, Legrand/Schneider listings). 4.5 and 6 kA are commonly sold; IEC 60898-1 Icn list not seen.

selection_vs_transformer.method: Isc = S / (sqrt3 x 400 V x z). Infinite HV source, bolted 3-phase fault at LV terminals, cable impedance ignored -> upper bound. Using 433 V gives ~8 % less.

guidance.suggest: 6 kA MCBs adequate even close to the transformer; 4.5 kA only if > ~30 m of service cable (check).
10 kA MCBs if the DB is near the transformer; 6 kA OK once service-cable impedance brings Isc below 6 kA (calculate).
Main incomer MCCB >= 16-25 kA at/near the transformer LV board; downstream 10 kA MCBs only after calculating cable impedance or using maker cascading tables.

selection_vs_transformer.note: Thresholds (6/10 kA steps) are this tool's suggestion derived from the computed Isc; not taken from a code. NEA transformer impedances not verified (IS 1180 values used).

poles.source: B3 cl. 9.0.1 & 9.1.2.1; B4 (sub-circuit: protective device on live conductor, neutral to common link); B5 Rule 59(2) isolating switch near meter

table.note: Device on phase only; neutral to DB neutral link (B4). Verified practice.

table.supply: 1-phase final circuit where neutral must also be switched
table.note: Common catalogue item; not a code requirement found.
Isolates phase and neutral together; Nepal rule requires an isolating switch near the meter (B5). Neutral must not open before phase (B3 9.0.1).

table.supply: 3-phase 4-wire incomer where neutral is switched but not protected
3-phase 4-wire incomer, 4P RCCB/RCBO, generator changeover where neutral must be switched/protected
table.note: RCDs must disconnect all phase conductors (B3 9.1.2.1).

frame_sizes_A.source: B8 (ABB XT1 160 A); Lauritz Knudsen DN0-DN4 / Schneider EasyPact CVS 100/160/250/400/630 seen only in reseller listings
frame_sizes_A.note: Frame steps are typical; exact list is manufacturer-specific.

icu_choices_kA.source: B8; L&T/LK listings (25/36/50 kA) not primary

thermal_adjustment.value: Ir adjustable approx 0.7-1.0 x In (TM-D) or 0.8-1.0 x In depending on make
thermal_adjustment.note: Only a reseller listing of Schneider CVS250B (0.7...1 x In) was seen; no primary catalogue retrieved. Treat as typical, confirm per make.

when_mccb_instead_of_mcb.rule: Use MCCB when In > 63 A (top of IEC 60898-1 MCB range in Indian catalogues; B7 0.5-63 A) or when prospective Isc exceeds the MCB's 10 kA, or when adjustable trip/selectivity is needed. Some makers sell 80-125 A MCBs (e.g. Legrand 3P 100 A 10 kA listing) - acceptable if Icn suffices.

selection.rule: In (frame/trip) >= IB; set Ir so IB <= Ir <= Iz; Icu >= prospective Isc at that point (Ics >= Isc preferred for main incomers).

table.meaning: Full-range breaking, general purpose - protects cables against overload and short circuit.
Partial-range, short-circuit protection of motor circuits only; must be associated with an overload device (thermal relay) because it must not operate for times above 60 s.

gG_conventional_currents.value: Inf 1.25 In (non-fusing), If 1.6 In (fusing) within conventional time 1-4 h depending on rating

cable_protection.rule: IB <= In <= Iz and I2 <= 1.45 Iz

selectivity.rule: gG-to-gG selectivity when ratio of ratings about 1.6

rating_series_A.note: Common IEC 60269 / Indian HRC steps; standard's preferred-value list not seen. Siemens 3NA steps 2/6/10/16/25/32/40/63/80/160/200 seen in B14/B15.

motor_backup_fuse_examples.note: See motor_starter tables (HRC 3NA back-up fuse column).

fuse_switch_unit.rule: Switch-fuse/fuse-switch rating >= fuse rating; for motor feeders AC-23 category (see isolator).

rccb_rcbo.standards: IEC 61008 (RCCB), IEC 61009 (RCBO), IEC 62423 (Type F/B), IS 12640 (Indian RCCB; extract in B1 App. G)

sensitivities_mA.source: B1 8.7 (30/100/300/500 mA as specified) and App. G.2.4 (preferred 10, 30, 100, 300 mA)

use.use: Additional protection against direct contact / final circuits, socket outlets, bathrooms (high sensitivity <=30 mA, B1 G.2.4)
Indirect-contact protection of groups of circuits (practice)
Fire protection / incomer, selective (S-type) upstream of 30 mA (practice; S-type requirement downstream of SPD in B4 6.4)

rated_current_limit.value: IS restricts RCCB rated current to the order of 125 A

types.source: B11 (ABB Type F brochure); B23 for EV (secondary)

table.use: Dimmers, SMPS, fans, AC units, general domestic (B11). Recommended default.

table.detects: A + mixed frequency up to 1 kHz, short-time delay, tolerates 10 mA smooth DC
table.use: Single-phase inverter/VFD loads (inverter ACs, washing machines, 1-ph pump drives) (B11).
Three-phase frequency converters/VFDs (B11: 'only RCD type B ... suitable to detect smooth DC ... three phase frequency converter').
Three-phase inverters with very high switching frequency (B11).

ev_charging.rule: Each EV charge point: 30 mA RCD at least Type A plus 6 mA DC detection (RDC-DD in charger, IEC 62955) or a Type B RCD; Type AC not allowed.

solar_inverter.rule: If inverter maker states it cannot feed smooth DC fault current into the AC side, Type A is used; otherwise Type B.
solar_inverter.note: IEC 60364-7-712 not accessed; follow inverter manual.

rating_vs_upstream.rule: RCCB has no overcurrent protection; its rated current In must be >= the rating of the MCB/fuse protecting it (series back-up), and its conditional short-circuit current must be >= prospective Isc with that back-up device.
rating_vs_upstream.source: B1 G.2.5 (back-up protection by fuse or MCB in series; RCBO alternative)
rating_vs_upstream.note: The '>= upstream' sizing statement is manufacturer practice; exact wording not found in a code.

spd_interaction.rule: If SPD is downstream of an RCD, use an S-type RCD with impulse immunity >= 3 kA 8/20.

table.use: Resistive loads incl. moderate overloads; can switch 150 % of rated current (B1)
Mixed resistive/inductive loads incl. moderate overloads; can switch 300 % of rated current (B1)
Highly inductive / motor loads; can interrupt stalled-motor current (B1)

rating_rule.rule: Isolator rated operational current Ie (in the right category at 415 V) >= rating of the protective device it is paired with (>= In of upstream/downstream MCB/MCCB/fuse) and >= IB. Use AC-22 for general DB incomers, AC-23 for motor feeders.
rating_rule.source: B1 Table 5 (categories); sizing step is practice

changeover_switch.rule: Mandatory where a standby generator is installed (Nepal Rule 57). Must be break-before-make, 4-pole for 3-phase 4-wire so neutral is switched; rating >= incomer.
changeover_switch.source: B5 Rule 57 (requirement only); B1 3.3 (viii) only one source may be switched on at a time

main_switch_at_meter.rule: Licensee installs sealed cutout/CB at meter; consumer installs isolating switch near meter.

dol_vs_star_delta.rule: Siemens Raja+ DOL range covers 0.25-7.5 kW (0.33-10 HP); submersible pump on DOL recommended max 5.5 kW / 7.5 HP (B14). Star-delta packages start at 7.5 kW/10 HP (B15, B16). Tool default: DOL <= 5.5 kW (submersible) / <= 7.5 kW (surface); star-delta above, motor must be delta-rated at 415 V.
dol_vs_star_delta.note: No NEA/Nepal limit on DOL size found.

contactor_rule.rule: DOL: contactor AC-3 rated current Ie >= motor FLC. Star-delta: line and delta contactors >= 0.58 x FLC, star contactor >= 0.33 x FLC.
contactor_rule.source: B16 (contactor choice by kW), 0.58/0.33 factors seen in multiple secondary sources; AC-3 definition B13

overload_relay.rule: DOL: relay range must include FLC; set to FLC. Star-delta with relay in delta loop (normal): set 0.58 x FLC and never higher than phase current (B15).

single_phasing_and_dry_run.rule: Siemens FASD includes a line-monitoring relay (7UG0613) for phase loss; dry-run protection for submersibles is a separate underload/level relay.
single_phasing_and_dry_run.note: No code requirement found; dry-run device recommendation is practice.

mpcb.rule: MPCB (IEC 60947-2/-4-1) can replace fuse+overload: set to FLC; Icu >= Isc.

dol_table_siemens_raja_415V.note: Two 5.5 kW rows exist (different relay range codes); cable column as printed.

star_delta_table_siemens_fasd.note: Rows reproduced as printed (some rows share a starter type; blanks = not printed). Row with IL 158 A appears to be a different motor design.

cable_lugs.standards: IS 8309 (copper crimp), IS 8394 (aluminium crimp) - standard texts not retrieved (IS 8394 scan unreadable)

size_rule.rule: Lug barrel size = conductor cross-section (copper lug on copper, aluminium lug on aluminium, bimetallic Al-Cu lug when Al cable lands on copper busbar/terminal). For flexible fine-strand cable a larger barrel may be needed.
size_rule.source: B18 (lugs specified per conductor size); bimetallic and fine-strand rule from maker listings, not standard

crimp.rule: Compression (hexagonal) crimp with die matched to lug size; tin-plated electrolytic copper for Cu.

stud_hole.rule: Hole size is chosen to match the equipment terminal stud, not the cable size; each conductor size is offered with several stud holes.

typical_stud_by_size.note: No Indian (Dowells/Comet) catalogue retrieved; do not auto-assign a stud by cable size - ask user for terminal stud or default to the device datasheet.

cable_glands.standards: BS 6121 / IS 12943 (double compression brass glands for armoured cable) - standard text not retrieved

rule.rule: Choose gland size whose outer-seal range brackets the measured cable outer sheath OD (armoured: also inner bedding range). Double-compression for armoured cable outdoors/industrial.
rule.source: B17; maker charts note ODs differ between cable makers - measure the actual cable

size_table_CMP.note: CMP T3CDS (armoured) and A2F (unarmoured). Indian Comet/Dowells ranges differ slightly; overlaps mean pick the size whose range centres on the OD.

space_factor.rule: Space factor (sum of cable overall areas / conduit internal area) does not exceed 40 % in the IS 732 tables.

min_size.rule: No steel conduit less than 20 mm; wall >= 1.6 mm up to 32 mm, >= 2 mm above.

pvc_conduit_table_SP30.source: B4 Part 1/Sec 20 Table 4 (1.1 kV single-core, rigid non-metallic conduit); identical figures in B3 Table 7 (OCR)
pvc_conduit_table_SP30.note: Conduit size = nominal outside diameter. 2.5 mm2 shows 10 in 25 mm and 14 in 32 mm (same as 1.5 mm2) in both SP 30 and IS 732 - reproduced as printed.

steel_conduit_table_CPWD.source: B1 Table I (PVC 650/1100 V cables IS 694, steel conduit)
steel_conduit_table_CPWD.note: S = straight runs <= 4.25 m between draw boxes with <= 15 deg deflection; B = runs with bends > 15 deg. Conduit size = nominal external diameter.

buried_duct.rule: Diameter of cable conduit/pipe/duct at least 1.5 x cable outer diameter; duct bend radius not less than 1.5 m (OCR 'J'S m'); the three single-core cables of one circuit in one duct (never singly in steel ducts).
buried_duct.note: HDPE/DWC catalogue sizes (e.g. 50/63/75/90/110/125/160 mm OD) not sourced - choose the next size whose ID >= 1.5 x OD.

rules: Plate at least 600 x 600 mm; GI/steel plate >= 6.3 mm thick; Cu plate >= 3.15 mm thick; top edge >= 1.5 m deep.
Pipes: cast iron >= 100 mm dia, 2.5-3 m long, 13 mm thick; or MS water pipe 38-50 mm; Amd 1: 40 mm GI pipe in treated pit or 40 mm MS rod driven in virgin soil, rod placed 1.25 m below ground.
Driven rods 13/16/19 mm dia, 1.22-2.44 m long; parallel rods spaced >= driven depth; 2 m separation already gives substantial gain.

Electrode >= 1.5 m from building; pipe top >= 20 cm below ground; plate top >= 3.0 m below ground (CPWD - deeper than IS 3043's 1.5 m); >= 2 m between electrodes; strip electrode >= 15 m long in trench >= 0.5 m deep.
Earthing conductor same material as electrode, not less than 4 mm dia Cu wire, 25 x 4 mm GI strip or 20 x 3 mm Cu strip; need not exceed 150 mm2 GI / 100 mm2 Cu.
Watering: 20 mm pipe for plate; 40 x 20 mm reducer for pipe electrode.

rows.installation: Indoor S/S with HT panel, transformer up to 1600 kVA, LT panel, DG
LT switch room with main LT board

substation_strips.note: Column alignment in the PDF text is ambiguous for rows 2-5; mapping above follows row order.

rules.value: Each electrode <= 5 ohm; up to 8 ohm in rocky soil
Lightning protection: each termination <= 10 x number of terminations ohm; whole system <= 10 ohm before bonding
IS 3043: no fixed target - resistance must be low enough to operate the earth-fault protection in the required time (coordinate with relay/RCD settings)

rules.note: Common practice figure; not found in IS 3043, SP 30 or CPWD text accessed.

chemical_earthing.rule: Artificial chemical treatment of soil is an allowed remedy when 5 ohm is not achieved (B1 8.6(ii)); IS 3043 warns of corrosion and water contamination from salt treatment (cl. 8.8.4).
chemical_earthing.note: Maintenance-free 'chemical earthing' electrode products (IS 3043 compliance claims) not evaluated.

rules: All metallic supports on HV systems permanently earthed (Rule 58).
Consumer: separate earthed circuit for water heater/AC; 3-pin sockets connected to earth; earthing per 'technically proper system' (Rule 60).

nbc_207.note: NBC 207 (Electrical Design Requirements for Public Buildings) text not found online; no Nepal numeric earth-resistance limit verified.

table.use: High exposure, e.g. line entrance to buildings with a lightning protection system
Point of use near sensitive equipment

uc_rule.derived: Uo 230 V -> Uc >= 253 V, so commercial Uc 275 V units satisfy it (verified example product B12). Uc 320 V/385 V units used where supply overvoltage is frequent - practice, not verified.

typical_house_type2.note: Example product (DEHN); ABB OVR T2 40-275 has same In/Imax per listings.

at_origin.rule: SP 30 6.4(b) text as published: at origin supplied by utility network, 'rated discharge current may be lower than 5 kA' - almost certainly a misprint of 'may not be lower than 5 kA' (IEC 60364-5-53).

when_recommended.rule: SP 30 requires main and branch DBs to be provided with SPD and earth-leakage device (incoming). Nepal Rule 56 places lightning protection duty on the licensee.

items: Only MCB/MCCB/HRC-fuse DBs; rewirable-fuse DBs not used (B1 3.3.2).
Separate DBs for light and power where possible; three-phase DBs not for final circuit distribution as far as possible (B1).
Each DB: reasonable spare outgoing ways; balance 3-phase circuits (B1 3.3 ix, x). No numeric spare % found.
Lighting circuit <= 800 W or <= 10 points; residential power circuit <= 2 x 16 A or <= 3 x 6 A outlets; non-residential power circuit 1 outlet (B1 3.10).
Prewired DB: copper busbar, phase/neutral/earth terminal blocks, DIN channel, incomer MCB/RCCB/RCBO/MCCB (B1 6.x).
Enclosure IP 42 minimum indoor, IP 54 outdoor for panels/bus trunking (B1 7.x).
Neutral of sub-circuits to a common link, individually disconnectable (B4).

ways_rule.rule: ways = number of outgoing circuits (+ incomer poles) rounded up to next catalogue size (4/6/8/12/16 way SPN; 4/6/8/12 way TPN) with spare ways

rule.text: Capacitive current supplied by capacitors directly across induction motor terminals should not exceed the motor's magnetizing current (to avoid transient torques and overvoltages / self-excitation). Higher correction must be a separate circuit with its own control gear.
rule.source: B4 Annex F Table 5 notes 2 and 3

table_SP30_kVAR.source: B4 Annex F Table 5 'Capacitor ratings at rated voltage'

general_kvar_formula.text: kVAR = kW x [tan(acos pf1) - tan(acos pf2)] (SP 30 Table 5 multiplying factors)

rmu.note: MSEDCL (India) spec; 22 kV version 16 kA 3 s. Other Indian utilities accept 18.4-21 kA (search summaries only).

pole_mounted.rule: Pole-mounted DT: gang-operated AB switch + drop-out (expulsion) fuses + gapless MO lightning arresters on HV side.
pole_mounted.note: Standard Indian/Nepali construction practice; NEA/REC construction standard not retrieved.

vcb.rule: VCB/CB with IDMT relay for larger or indoor substations (>= ~630 kVA or where RMU used).

rating_36kV.value: 36 kV switchgear for 33 kV systems; 630 A / 25 kA typical

hrc_current_limiting_ABB_CEF_S.basis: IEC 60787 & IEC 62271-105; transformer overload 120 %; inrush 12 x In for 100 ms (<=800 kVA), 10 x In (>800 kVA); '*' = fuse cannot clear LV terminal short circuit on its own. For other line voltages use the next smaller voltage row.
hrc_current_limiting_ABB_CEF_S.note: 11 kV row ends at 400 kVA in the table (6/12 kV CEF-S max 63 A). 33 kV: per ABB note use the next smaller row (30 kV). Ratio fuse/FLC is 2-4x, i.e. larger than a '1.5-2x FLC' rule because of the inrush criterion.

rule_of_thumb_1_5_to_2_FLC.note: Not supported by the sourced ABB table (which gives ~2-4x HV FLC).

do_fuse_element.note: NEA/REC table of DO fuse-element ratings vs kVA not found. Foreign example (Power & Water, Australia, B26, search summary only): 11 kV EDO 25 kVA 5 A, 63 kVA 8 A, 100 kVA 16 A. Do not use without NEA confirmation.

33kV.note: From search summary only; document not retrievable.

11kV_station_10kA.note: 9 kV / 10 kA station class seen only in search summaries/retail listings.

rule.text: Select kit by (1) voltage grade Uo/U (6.35/11 kV, 19/33 kV), (2) cores (1C/3C), (3) indoor vs outdoor (outdoor has rain sheds), (4) conductor size range, (5) technology heat-shrink or cold-shrink; straight-through joints likewise by size range.
rule.source: B24 (size groups); Raychem HST indoor / HVT outdoor conforming IS 13573-2 per retail listings (search only)

example_size_groups_11kV_3C_mm2.note: One maker (SPS); Raychem and 3M use different groupings.

ct.rule: CT primary >= transformer HV FLC (and >= CB-rated current if CB is the limit); e.g. MSEDCL RMU transformer CB uses dual-ratio 100-50/1 A class 5P10.

relay.value: Self-powered IDMT O/C + E/F relay, 3 s IDMT characteristic; O/C setting range 10-200 % of CT secondary, E/F 10-40 %

pickup_rule.value: O/C pickup about 1.2-1.5 x transformer FLC; E/F 10-40 % of CT rating; grade with LV main and upstream feeder (0.3-0.4 s margin)
pickup_rule.note: Only textbook/worked-example sources (1.25x, 1.5x) found; no utility setting guideline accessed.

flc_and_fault_table.method: Isc = S / (sqrt3 x 400 V x z). Infinite HV source, bolted 3-phase fault at LV terminals, cable impedance ignored -> upper bound. Using 433 V gives ~8 % less.

rows.z_source: assumed 4.5 % (50 kVA not in IS 1180 Table 1; 25 and 63 kVA are 4.5 %)

lv_incomer.rule: LV main breaker (MCCB/ACB) rated current >= transformer LV FLC (next standard frame above FLC; adjustable Ir set at ~FLC, allowing for permitted overload); Icu >= LV terminal Isc in table. LT cable/busbar sized for the breaker setting.
lv_incomer.source: B4 breaking-capacity clause; B10 'max LV gG fuse' row gives the largest LV fuse that still coordinates with the HV CEF-S fuse
lv_incomer.note: The 'FLC x 1.0-1.25' factor is practice; not found in an accessible standard.

nepal_context.voltage: 230 V 1-ph / 400 V 3-ph +/-5 %, 50 Hz (Electricity Rules 2050 Rule 40/43 - see lv_reference.json)
